blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) and RL Commercial REIT, Inc. (RCR) have secured three major wins for the Robinsons Malls portfolio at the Retail Asia Awards 2026. Organized by Charlton Media Group, a regional business media and events company, the Retail Asia Awards honor outstanding achievements and transformative contributions across the Asia-Pacific retail sector.

Robinsons Malls was recognized with Eco-Friendly Mall of the Year - Philippines for Robinsons Magnolia, New Mall of the Year - Philippines for Robinsons Pagadian, and Regional Mall of the Year - Philippines for Robinsons Malolos.

The accolades strengthen the group’s position as one of the Philippines' leading property developers. Through Robinsons Malls, RLC continues to create destinations that serve as the heart of the communities they operate in.

blocks.alt: Robinsons Malls celebrates Filipino excellence on the international stage by winning Eco-Friendly Mall of the Year, New Mall of the Year, and Regional Mall of the Year
blocks.cap: Celebrating Filipino excellence on the international stage, Robinsons Malls won three prestigious awards at the Retail Asia Awards 2026

blocks.html: "These recognitions show how Robinsons Land Corporation is expanding as a proudly Filipino company, meeting the evolving needs of communities nationwide,” said Faraday D. Go, Executive Vice President and Group Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Malls and Robinsons Destination Estates. "Across our portfolio, we remain committed to building future-ready destinations that generate long-term value, empower communities, and contribute to the country's continued growth."

blocks.cap: A massive, record-breaking crowd gathers to experience the grand opening day of Robinsons Pagadian

blocks.html: Since its April 2025 opening, Robinsons Pagadian has transformed the Zamboanga Peninsula’s retail and entertainment landscape. The mall introduced the city’s first-ever cinemas and a mix of global and local brands, drawing a record-breaking crowd on its opening day.

In Central Luzon, Robinsons Malolos stands as a premier cultural, economic, and civic hub. The mall serves as a proud venue for major local events, while seamlessly bringing top retail brands, dining, and essential government services under one roof.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Malolos serves as a vibrant hub for commerce, culture, and community life in Central Luzon.

blocks.html: “At Robinsons Malls, we believe our role extends far beyond retail,” said Ma. Kristina Real-Lim, Deputy Business Unit General Manager for Robinsons Malls. “Our developments stand as the heart of communities we serve, where people connect, celebrate life’s milestones, access essential services, and share meaningful everyday experiences.”

Robinsons Magnolia’s Eco-Friendly Mall of the Year recognition underscores the group’s commitment to sustainability. Through renewable energy adoption, waste management programs, green mobility initiatives, and resource-efficient design, Robinsons Malls continues to integrate environmental responsibility into its operations while building resilient developments for long-term community benefit.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Magnolia demonstrates how sustainable developments can create vibrant spaces that enhance community life.

blocks.html: These latest recognitions build on Robinsons Malls' growing track record of excellence at the Retail Asia Awards, having previously won New Mall of the Year for Opus and Regional Mall of the Year for Robinsons Antipolo.

blocks.alt: Robinsons Malls continues to champion its mission of building better lives through world class spaces.
blocks.cap: Robinsons Malls continues to champion its mission of building better lives through world-class spaces.

blocks.html: For Robinsons Malls, these awards reflect an enduring commitment to shaping the retail landscape, unlocking opportunities, and building better lives. As one of the country's largest mall operators, RLC continues to elevate everyday experiences for millions of Filipinos through purposeful, community-driven developments.
